title: In-camera playback of 3840 x 2560 clips, part 3 of 3 (F29): the playback format set-up gives a 3840-wide picture of 2,160 rows or more clip size 0x17
status: the one word of page 2 of the contributed avdec8k_a6700_v2 (its author reports playback on an A6700; no logs seen), split off because readcheck.c level 29 carries one code page. Disassembled and emulated here; not run by us on any camera
